essence: One should then worship Medhā in the directions outside the square.
Śakra and the other directional deities are to be worshipped again on the eight-petaled lotus with two syllables each.
One should worship Śrī with the Śrī bīja mantra beginning with tārā and ending with namas.
One should worship Śivā on the rada-petal with the eight-syllable mantra.
One should worship Tripurā on the sixty-four-petaled lotus with the nine-syllable mantra.
